stories.title: Estas son las marchas previstas para este 28 de septiembre; prevén afectaciones viales

en.title: These are the marches scheduled for September 28; road disruptions expected
en.summary: Multiple demonstrations are planned throughout the day at various locations in the capital, with authorities warning of traffic impacts.

stories.title: Ernesto Ruffo llega a su hogar en Ensenada tras viaje de 40 horas en carretera; enfrentará prisión domiciliaria

en.title: Ernesto Ruffo arrives at his home in Ensenada after 40-hour road trip; will face house arrest
en.summary: The former governor of Baja California returned home after a long journey and is now subject to home confinement.

stories.title: Nvidia lanza una plataforma para controlar y frenar a los agentes de IA que se salgan de sus límites

en.title: Nvidia launches a platform to control and limit AI agents that exceed their boundaries
en.summary: Nvidia introduced a new platform designed to manage and restrict artificial intelligence agents that operate beyond their defined parameters following recent security incidents.

stories.title: Huracán Polo: Autoridades llaman a resguardarse ante impacto en Baja California Sur

en.title: Hurricane Polo: Authorities urge residents to take shelter ahead of impact in Baja California Sur
en.summary: Hurricane Polo approaches Baja California Sur with maximum sustained winds of 185 kilometers per hour; federal and state authorities strengthened precautions and instructed residents to seek shelter.

stories.title: Nvidia lanza plataforma de ciberseguridad para controlar agentes de IA; pretende evitar que desarrolladores escapen del control humano

en.title: Nvidia launches cybersecurity platform to control AI agents; aims to prevent developers from escaping human control
en.summary: Nvidia released an open cybersecurity platform backed by over one hundred industry partners including Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, Perplexity, and Accenture to manage artificial intelligence agents.

stories.title: Alertan por impacto de huracán Polo en BCS y Sonora; dan seguimiento a tormenta tropical Rachel

en.title: Alert issued for Hurricane Polo impact on Baja California Sur and Sonora; tropical storm Rachel being monitored
en.summary: Hurricane Polo threatened Baja California Sur and Sonora with intensifying winds and waves, while authorities tracked tropical storm Rachel.

stories.title: Llega Ruffo a Ensenada para cumplir prisión domiciliaria

en.title: Ruffo arrives in Ensenada to serve house arrest
en.summary: Ernesto Ruffo completed a 40-hour overland transfer and arrived at his home in Ensenada, Baja California, where he will serve house arrest.

stories.title: VIDEOS: SpaceX coloca Starship en órbita por primera vez; inicia despliegue de satélites de internet

en.title: SpaceX places Starship in orbit for the first time; begins deploying internet satellites
en.summary: SpaceX successfully orbited Starship for the first time, reaching an altitude of approximately 275 kilometers and completing about six orbits while deploying internet satellites.

stories.title: Megacohete Starship alcanza por primera vez la órbita terrestre

en.title: Megacohete Starship reaches Earth orbit for first time
en.summary: Elon Musk's Starship megacohete successfully reached Earth orbit for the first time following a launch from Texas, marking a significant milestone in the vehicle's development for planned lunar and Mars missions.

stories.title: Despliega megacohete Starship satélites en órbita terrestre

en.title: Starship megacohete deploys satellites in Earth orbit
en.summary: Elon Musk's Starship megacohete launched and reached Earth orbit while deploying 26 next-generation Starlink satellites.

stories.title: Huracán Polo sigue como categoría 3 y tormenta tropical Rachel avanza; sigue EN VIVO su avance y efectos

en.title: Hurricane Polo continues as Category 3; tropical storm Rachel advances; tracking live updates and impacts
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintains maximum winds of 185 km/h while approaching Baja California Sur, while tropical storm Rachel brings heavy rainfall to Guerrero and Oaxaca.

stories.title: Prevén que toque tierra hoy en BCS como huracán categoría 2

en.title: Expected to make landfall today in Baja California Sur as Category 2 hurricane
en.summary: Hurricane Polo, currently at Category 3 strength, is expected to make landfall in Baja California Sur, with winds intensifying as the system approaches.

stories.title: El mexicano que ayudó a que el proyecto de Google despegara desde Stanford

en.title: The Mexican who helped launch Google's project from Stanford
en.summary: A Mexican Stanford professor assisted Google founders Page and Brin in developing their search engine by providing servers, equipment, and storage space needed for the BackRub project.

stories.title: Aguinaldo 2026: cuándo se paga, cuánto te corresponde y qué pasa si trabajaste menos de un año

en.title: 2026 Bonus: when it is paid, how much you receive and what happens if you worked less than a year
en.summary: Mexico's annual year-end bonus can be calculated in advance using accumulated work days and daily salary, with specific rules for employees with less than one year of service.
